sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: You know *ugyebár*, *mégiscsak* and *éppenséggel* from B2 Unit 13; this lesson adds *elvégre* and *netalán*, and shows how the particles make a remark ironic. *Ugyebár* invites complicity while secretly questioning the assertion: *A miniszter úr, ugyebár, tévedhetetlen.* (The Minister, mind you, is infallible).

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: *Elvégre* (after all) often rationalizes an absurd situation with fake fatalism, while *netalán* feigns polite innocence to suggest a scandalous possibility: *Netalán azt tetszik állítani, hogy a pénz eltűnt?*

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: A szabályokat, ugyebár, mindenkinek be kell tartania.
Rules, mind you, must be observed by everyone. (ironic)
After all, nothing bad could have happened... (feigned innocence)
Netalán kételkedni mer a hivatalos verzióban?
Perchance you dare doubt the official version?
